title: JA Voyara j6 1.0.12: the brand step reads a T4 kit whose logo spots are written through the site profile, with no content map frame
steps: S1: Load the committed contracts/ja-voyara/j6/1.0.12/template-kit.json (logo-header-1 and logo-footer-1: setting site_logo, frameId null) and run kitProblem from apps/tracy-web/src/brand-step/kit-grounds.js on it.
S2: Run kitProblem on the JA Boxing kit with the frames of its site_logo spots removed, and again after its favicon mechanism is changed to a WordPress option.
expect: S1: kitProblem returns null, so the Road to live Template kit step no longer holds Voyara on kit-brand-unreadable.
S2: with a T4 site profile the spots need no frame (null); without one the spots are refused as having no frame to write them.
evidence: Before this change the Road to live gate on the packed Voyara 1.0.12 kit returned todo kit-brand-unreadable; after it, todo kit-not-approved, and done kit-approved once approved
fence: Pure function on the committed kit; the brand write on a live site is covered by the write step tests
